Before & Afters Specials Memberships Shop Online Menu of Services Book Now Current Specials Book Online Home / Blog and News / Beth O’Brien, RN Beth O’Brien, RN After a transformative summer volunteering in Indian orphanages and supporting women, Beth earned her Nursing degree from Maine College of Health Professions. She began her career as an OR nurse at Dartmouth Hitchcock residency program. When the COVID-19 pandemic reduced surgeries, Beth transitioned to Home Hospice, providing invaluable support to patients and their loved ones during end-of-life journeys. It was during this time that her passion for aesthetics nursing developed, helping patients feel confident and good about themselves, especially in the new era of virtual connections. After several years of travel nursing, Beth is delighted to be back in Maine, serving as a nurse for Hospice of Southern Maine and the team at Cosmetic Enhancement Center. Her favorite treatment is Sculptra, valuing its collagen-building capabilities and the subtle, natural lift it provides.
